title: Water Leak Sensor Instant Alert
dataSources: Zigbee2MQTT device reports (`zigbee2mqtt:device`), Shelly/Tasmota telemetry (`shelly:status`, `tasmota:sensor`), Hue events (`hue:event`), thermostats (`ecobee:thermostat`).
app: Philips Hue, smart plugs (Tasmota/Shelly/TP-Link Kasa), thermostats (Nest/Ecobee), locks, and Zigbee/Z-Wave sensors via MQTT / Zigbee2MQTT bridged to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=zigbee2mqtt:device water_leak=true
| stats max(_time) as detected, latest(friendly_name) as sensor by friendly_name
| eval detected=strftime(detected,"%F %T")
| sort - detected
description: Fires the instant any leak sensor reports water, because minutes matter when a washing machine hose or boiler starts leaking.
value: Water damage is among the costliest home disasters; a real-time leak alert can be the difference between a mopped floor and a ruined ceiling.
implementation: Bridge leak-sensor state to HEC; schedule at the shortest interval and send a high-priority push the moment water is detected.
visualization: Single-value alert panel with the triggering sensor and time.
grandmaExplanation: It shouts the moment a leak sensor gets wet, so you can stop a small leak before it wrecks the floor.
